sourceNote: packages/develop-engine/crates and Cargo.lock are identical between executableBuildCommit and sourceCommit; colorcheck matches sourceCommit. holdout verifies the evaluator script SHA-256 and both frozen executable hashes.
build: cargo +1.98.1 build --release --locked --manifest-path packages/develop-engine/Cargo.toml -p niho-develop --example analytic_hs_calibrate --example analytic_hs_probe

executables.note: Studio build of executableBuildCommit; the private work directory keeps these exact files. A rebuild elsewhere may differ in bytes (embedded paths) and must be recorded before the evaluation, never after.

evaluationManifest.command: python3 packages/develop-engine/tools/calibrate/fit_analytic_hs.py --repo <checkout whose crates and tools equal sourceCommit (checked by git diff)> --work <new private directory> holdout --cohort <new photos> --freeze packages/develop-engine/fixtures/color/review-2026-10-21/analytic-hs-freeze.json [--probe <frozen analytic_hs_probe>]
evaluationManifest.cohort: manifest.json (scenes with scene, date, model, iso, band), inputs/<scene>__neutral.jpg, lr-export/<scene>__<variant>.jpg

subsets.brightIphone: iPhone, band bright (ISO <= 100), bright windows / sky

selection.rule: metadata only (capture date, model, ISO); one scene per capture date; capture dates not used by teachers, teachers2 or the sealed independent set; no pixel inspection before the run
selection.blankInputs: excluded when 90% or more of the input pixels are >= 250 (fit_niho6_response.blank_input)

variants.lightroomExport: make_lr_p3_jpeg.py 22 settings or neutral + 3 presets; JPEG 100%, sRGB, full size, output sharpening off, lens corrections off
variants.settings: analytic_hs_calibrate settings: new niho-10 edit (look niho-standard-1); presets through xmp::apply_preset at amount 1

gate.reported: both the every-scene p99 <= 8 rule and the JPEG 15% rule, per subset, and paired regressions against niho-10

evaluationManifest.once: The evaluator script and both executables must match the freeze; holdout validates all three non-blank subset minimums before writing holdout-started.json, then reads references once and refuses a second run. Coefficients, formula and thresholds are never changed after seeing the result.

independentEvaluation.dryRun: the holdout command was exercised once on one development teacher image in a throwaway work directory (not an independent evaluation)
